version.author: berlogabob
version.changelog: Read peaks from the item's project position instead of project time 0 — regions were wrong for any item not starting at 0:00. Derive channel count from the source instead of assuming stereo. Re-running now replaces its own regions instead of duplicating them. Report which render settings were changed.

version.author: berlogabob
version.changelog: Ship as one package with three actions and a shared library. Add percussion hit splitting and SFZ / Decent Sampler preset building.
